guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, fsm_digest_done_q is cleared to 0, regardless of fsm_digest_done_d.
On rising edge of clk_i, when rst_ni is high, fsm_digest_done_q takes the value of fsm_digest_done_d.

assumptions.claim: The reset signal rst_ni must meet removal/recovery timing relative to clk_i. If deasserted too close to the clock edge, fsm_digest_done_q may become metastable.
assumptions.cond: when rst_ni is released asynchronously near posedge clk_i
assumptions.risk: Metastable fsm_digest_done_q could cause downstream logic to prematurely read an incomplete digest (exposing internal state) or miss a valid completion, breaking cryptographic integrity.
